case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised breakfast, cleanliness, comfortable rooms and friendly reception/staff, and several noted good facilities, food and the indoor pool/buffet. Some breakfast-related negatives appeared: a few found the orange juice and espresso flavors off and one guest mentioned limited day-to-day variety. Isolated comments included bed configuration (two beds instead of a double) and absence of a bidet shower in one bathroom.
